Replace this binary with the newest build on its channel.

stable is the tagged releases. dev is rebuilt from main on every commit,
so it carries unreleased work -- useful for trying a fix before it ships.
A channel given here is remembered for next time.

## Usage

```console
llm-helper upgrade [flags]
```

## Options

### --channel

|      |          |
| ---- | -------- |
| Type | `string` |

release channel: stable or dev (default: remembered, else stable)

### --check

|      |        |
| ---- | ------ |
| Type | `bool` |

report what's available without installing it
